action.rationale: g2g4 was refuted at depth 3: -121 after Bxg4, losing a pawn and exposing the king; its depth-2 +34 was shallow. e2e4 scores +18 at depth 2, verifies safe (no mate-in-one), develops/opens the center, and its depth-2 PV avoids the g4 blunder line. Deeper evidence on g2g4 outweighs the shallower comparison, so e2e4 is the sounder commit.
action.objective: Open the center with e2e4, meeting Bxe4 and keeping the b7 knight covered by tactics after Qxb7.
